pitch:
Coast: your Monday content batch for every client, in each client's own voice, approved by the client before it goes out.
Paste 5 to 10 of a client's best past posts (English or Lithuanian) and Coast learns that voice; then ask for a week of captions, ideas or Reels/TikTok scripts per client.
Send the client one approval link (works from WhatsApp or email): they approve or comment on each post, no login. Approved posts export in one click as a CSV for your scheduler's bulk upload.
Prices (euros per month, cancel anytime): Solo 15 (5 clients), Studio 29 (15 clients), Agency 59 (unlimited clients, 3 team seats). Fair use: about 1,500 AI requests a month per account.
Free trial: 14 days on your real clients, no card. Guarantee: if a client rejects the voice in your first paid month, that month is refunded.
Founding members (first 50 accounts): Studio for 19 a month, price locked for 12 months. Run by a named founder in Lithuania; client data stored in the EU and not used to train AI models.
